summary: The root نفل (nafal) refers to something extra or exceeding the original. It can mean a voluntary gift, alms, or a good deed beyond what is obligatory.
lane: نَافِلَةٌ ذ : the pl. نَوَافِلُ , is explained in the TA, art. حرز , by زَوَائِدُ [ Accessions, or additions ]. -b2- What accedes to, or exceeds, the original. (T.) A voluntary gift, by way of alms, or as a good work: (T:) a gift: (K:) or a gift عَنْ يَدٍ : (M:) a deed beyond what is incumbent, or obligatory. (M, K.) -b3- نَافِلَةٌ Supererogatory prayer. (S, Msb.) See تَطَوَّعَ .
